notes.printCues: T37: case-insensitive patterns that show the earliest page credits print (an ISBN, page or volume numbers, a journal, a book, a dated study). A typed boundary of print counts only if one matches the sentence or the text around it.
notes.editableDomains: T37: pages anyone can edit. A typed boundary of unsourced counts only on one of these domains, and only when the page cites nothing beside the sentence.
